errors.text_span: Година и месец, за което се отнася подкрепката
errors.evidence: The x-axis label in the image is 'Година и месец, за които се отнася подкрепата', but the description uses 'което' instead of 'които'.

errors.text_span: достига връх от около 6,8% през януари 2021 г.
errors.evidence: The description identifies the peak of the line at 6.8% in January 2021. However, the actual peak is higher, over 7%, and occurs in March-April 2021.
The description states that after the peak, the line 'gradually decreases'. This is an over-generalization, as there is a very sharp and significant drop in mid-2021.

errors.text_span: спад до около 3,2% през април 2020 г.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies a dip to ~3.2% in April 2020. The chart shows that April 2020 (month 4) was a local peak at approximately 6.5%. A dip does occur in June 2020 (month 6) to about 3.5%.

errors.text_span: връх от около 6,8% през януари 2021 г.
errors.evidence: This is a repetition of a previous error, incorrectly identifying the peak of the graph. The true peak is over 7% in March-April 2021.
